Organizing involves structuring resources and tasks to achieve goals effectively. It includes job design, grouping jobs, and determining the hierarchy of an organization. Organizational authority, culture, and socialization are key components. The objective is to optimize communication and coordination to achieve a goal while avoiding silos. Leadership and selection are crucial in maintaining and changing culture.
